关于我

我是一名对绿植和自然景观充满热情的设计师,我特别擅长参数化模型设计，对Grasshopper有着深入的理解和应用。
我精通Sketchup，并且自创了一些动态组件的建模方法，这些创新技术极大地提高了我的工作效率和设计质量。此外，我还熟悉一些节能分析软件，如Ladybug，这让我能够在设计中融入可持续发展的理念。
我相信，我的专业技能和不断探索的精神将使我能够在设计领域不断进步，创造出更多令人满意的作品。

About Me

I am a designer who is passionate about green plants and natural landscapes. I am particularly skilled in parametric model design and have a deep understanding and application of Grasshopper.
I am proficient in Sketchup and have created some modeling methods for dynamic components. These innovative technologies have greatly improved my work efficiency and design quality. In addition, I am also familiar with some energy-saving analysis software, such as Ladybug, which allows me to integrate sustainable development concepts into my design.
I believe that my professional skills and spirit of continuous exploration will enable me to continuously improve in the field of design and create more satisfactory works.
